e22_esb_population: Four rows of the pad-30s probe media variant, chosen before any contact by naming the SAME four published segments the 2026-09-06 dev1500 smoke selected (longest, shortest, median and p90 by duration over the drawn 1,500, ties broken by sample id): 4469088-654, 4479944-334, 4482383-188, 4482613-439. Naming the segments rather than re-ranking by this variant's own durations is deliberate -- it keeps every cell's smoke on the same four recordings, so a VRAM or encode surprise is attributable to the encoding factor and not to a different draw.
e22_esb_variant_factor: the acoustic tail at the classic Whisper length: digital silence appended up to exactly 30.0 s, the input length the 30-second convention would deliver, so the zero-pad block sits about 30 s away from the last word instead of against it. No clip is truncated; the one clip already past 30.0 s is byte-identical to its dev-v1 twin.
e22_esb_identity_hash_convention: e22_esb_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('earnings22-original', sample_ids)) over earnings22-original/<call>-<segment>@p30, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and the value an exposure row must carry. It DIFFERS from the dev-v1 population's c626e62f... by construction: a variant clip never shares an identifier with its dev-v1 twin, so no receipt, reference lookup or paired join can silently mix the two populations.
e22_esb_media_root: The 1,500 variant WAVs live under $SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR/derived/e22-esb-utterances/dev1500-pad30s-v1 and never enter Git (1440158160 bytes). They are deterministic transformations of the sealed dev-v1 bytes, each source file re-hashed against the committed D1 media supplement before it was read; no parent MP3 was opened and no decoder ran, so librosa never runs and the pinned absence of ffmpeg is preserved.
e22_esb_d1_media_supplement: The 1,500 @p30 ids enter D1's identity closure through the additive media supplement named above (schema saea-d1-media-supplement-v1, the shape contracts.gate_media_identity reads); it chains to the same parent D1 identity artifact the dev-v1 and dev1500 supplements chain to, and binds to this population's own probe view through source_binding_sha256 c1dcd6b8.
e22_esb_split_role_basis: No owner allowance is involved and none is claimed. These ten calls ARE this study's registered earnings22-original dev subset10 (docs/receipts/splits.json, split 'dev', count 10, identity 89b178d6b1ef46d9ca820ae54349e3d2099c60cde6d6b753ef9f66137c310028), which is the split this study may optimize on, and every published segment here was already read by the sealed 2026-09-05 arms. No confirmatory call is named, loaded, decoded, scored or read by this fragment or by any run that composes it, and the six calibration-exposed ESB test calls stay a separate population with a separate roster, a separate reference layer and a separate derived media root.
e22_esb_reference_boundary: The 'sentence' column is gold and NEVER enters the request path. The roster receipt this fragment names carries identifiers, media paths, measured media identity and segment spans only. References live in the SAME hash-pinned dev10 derived layer the sealed dev arms were scored against, unedited, and the published segment key is recovered by splitting the sample id on '@' -- reproduction.esb_reference performs that split, so a variant row scores against its own published sentence and against nothing else.
e22_esb_window_fit: The longest utterance is 32.880000 s. On the exact front-end rule the 2026-09-07 encoding audit derived and proved against 6,038 sealed prompt_tokens -- 13 tokens per 100 mel frames, n_eff = n_samples // 160 + 1 -- that is 429 speech tokens. Worst required = 429 speech + the 49-token arm A text envelope the same audit measured + 1024 completion + 2 special = about 1504, against the 5,120-token slot the -c 40960 -np 8 geometry gives: a ratio of 3.40x on this repository's own slot_tokens >= 2 x worst rule.
e22_esb_exposure: Pre-flight 4-row dry run required by section 6 of docs/readiness/2026-09-07-e22-dev-encoding-probes-v1-preregistration.md. Each cell's smoke is its own run id with its own exposure row, because contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's, and four rows have a different split identity hash and a much smaller budget than 1,500.
